name: Tessera Personal Pod
description: A single-occupant autonomous vehicle the size of a large armchair, enclosed in a transparent shell. The Pod is Tessera's vision of personal urban transport — you sit inside your climate-controlled bubble and it drives you wherever you need to go at city speeds. No parking needed; it drops you off and drives itself to the next customer. In Tier 3-4 districts, Pods fill the streets like chrome eggs, each containing a person staring at their own reflection in someone else's Pod. It's efficient, antisocial, and a perfect metaphor for the city.
armament: None. Transparent shell provides no protection or privacy.
common_usage: Solo commuting, short urban trips, a mobile private space in a crowded city.
story_hooks: Pods are being used as mobile dead drops — someone leaves a data chip under the seat, and the next passenger finds it
A Pod's autonomous system routes its passenger through a district they've never seen, where the streets don't match any map, before delivering them to their destination as if nothing happened
related_entities: Axiom Systems White Noise Bubble Generator WNB-1
physical_description: A teardrop-shaped capsule roughly the size of a reclining chair, built from scuffed polycarbonate and dull aluminum frames. The transparent shell shows hairline stress fractures and condensation residue from countless commutes; interior upholstery is worn synthetic leather the color of old concrete, with exposed foam padding where the seats have split. The pod's undercarriage is visible through the translucent floor—exposed servos, battery casings, and jury-rigged suspension components.
